summary: Extends OSPF to define independent IP topologies called Multi-Topologies. They can compute different paths for unicast, multicast, different classes of service, or an in-band management topology. An optional extension can exclude selected links. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: One city map can have separate maps for buses, bikes, and trucks. This lets a routing system keep different maps for different kinds of traffic.
